description: The best-graded services in one category, sorted by Safety (default) or Privacy, with services that never or rarely ask for ID first and those whose terms let them demand ID (KYC level 3) after them. Services that require ID from every user are left out, as on the site. Optionally keep only services with given features.

must_have.description: Feature keys to require, e.g. ["monero", "no-account", "onion"]. list_categories shows the keys for each category.

name: rank_category
title: Rank a category
